Maya (marketing): quick brainstorm - need final benchmark narrative for launch email + webinar. focus: practical heatmap + routing. 5 min takes pls :wave:
Ethan (growth): keep routing explicit. we need thresholds to wire forms. suggest intent_score + avg_context_length + org_size
Noor (product): propose 3 slices: PLG (short prompts, low cost, <200ms), SMB (medium), Enterprise (long, higher cost). annotate heatmap with example SLO per slice
Ivy (design): i'll do a single-slide heatmap and a backup slide with 3 quick case callouts. figma later today
Kai (demand): webinar polls: which slice are you? primary SLO? interest in trial? use poll to collect emails
Maya (marketing): copy hooks: tech lead variant and PM variant. short headline: "Heatmaps, not guesswork: pick the inference path that fits your SLOs"
Ethan (growth): BenchBot - sample webhook payloads for demo router?
BenchBot: uploaded samples: drive/bench_demo/{plg.json,smb.json,enterprise.json} and routing_rules.csv :robot_face:
Noor (product): add one-liner on fallbacks: "Requests transparently fall back to compatible model variants when fastpath is full."
Maya (marketing): action items: Ivy -> slide + annotations, Noor -> fallback line + sample payloads, Ethan -> poll + routing matrix, Kai -> panel invites, me -> post copy + landing. deadline EOD tomorrow.
Ivy (design): noted. will use colorblind-safe palette. :ok_hand:
Maya (marketing): thanks all - will assemble and ping for review tomorrow AM. :rocket:
